about: Per-area atmosphere moods: the haze (room settings haze_density, haze_anisotropy) and the ground fog (env fog) that pc/tools/generate_lighting.py writes into the generated layer. A zone entry applies its mood to all its rooms or only to those open to the sky (pc/tools/outdoor.py); other rooms open to the sky take outdoor_default; roofed rooms not listed get nothing (the project's default faint haze). Fields as in lighting/README.md, 'Environment'. See pc/docs/Vulkan_Renderer.md, 'Haze, ground fog and sun shafts'.

forest.why: Snowfly Forest: low ground mist between the trees, moonlight streaming through the canopy

undercity.why: Undercity: damp, still haze and a cold mist on the floor of the sewers

town_night.why: Lea Monde's streets, walls and the Keep at night: a faint moonlit haze, a thin mist low on the streets (subtle: the streets stay readable from every angle; faint moon shafts)

night.why: Any other room open to the sky: a faint moonlit haze
